gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization grade IV glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I/II trial tests the safety and side effects of atezolizumab in combination with cabozantinib

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients at either first or second recurrence will be considered eligible

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Profiling tumor immune cell populations (i.e., macrophage migration inhibitory factor \[mIF\] and immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] analyses of CD4, CD8, PD1, PD-L1, and PD-L2 expression).

role_evidence.quote: Atezolizumab and Cabozantinib for the Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: monoclonal antibody that may help the body's immune system attack the cancer

agents.drug_class_hint: multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGFR, MET, AXL)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth

source_quote.quote: Profiling tumor immune cell populations (i.e., macrophage migration inhibitory factor \[mIF\] and immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] analyses of CD4, CD8, PD1, PD-L1, and PD-L2 expression).

coder_notes: Both drugs are investigational in a single-arm combination, hence experimental_combination. Grade IV glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma) with no IDH requirement, coded historical. PD-L1 is only a correlative marker, not an entry requirement. Target engagement unclear: tumour immune profiling is listed as a correlative objective but not explicitly pre/post treatment.
